name: Prometheus

trigger alerts when metric conditions are met
query time series data with PromQL

setup.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/prom && cat > /tmp/prom/targets.json <<'EOF'
[{"targets":["127.0.0.1:9090"],"labels":{"env":"demo","team":"sre"}}]
EOF
cat > /tmp/prom/your_config.yml <<'EOF'
global:
  scrape_interval: 2s
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: prometheus
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["localhost:9090"]
  - job_name: filesd
    file_sd_configs:
      - files: ["/tmp/prom/targets.json"]
EOF

smoke_tests.command: curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9090/api/v1/query --data-urlencode 'query=up{team="sre"}' && echo && curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9090/api/v1/query --data-urlencode 'query=count by (job) (up == 1)'

pitfalls.actually_needed: Binaries go to ~/go/bin, which is not on PATH by default; called as ~/go/bin/prometheus. Version string is empty (no ldflags) with go install.
Go toolchain (box had Go 1.27.4); build took ~150s. Server was run from the repo root, as the README advises for go install builds (web assets).
Wrote own config; also passed --storage.tsdb.path=/tmp/prom/data to keep data out of the repo dir.

judge.observed: Prometheus reports healthy, both file-SD and static targets are up, PromQL queries return success with expected results, and --version prints build info (empty version string from a source build).
